name: TigerConnect

long_description:
TigerConnect is an enterprise clinical communication and collaboration platform designed to replace fragmented communication methods (pagers, personal phones, faxes) with a unified, HIPAA-compliant solution. The platform enables secure text messaging, voice calls, and video visits between care team members and with patients.

The platform goes beyond basic messaging to include clinical workflow features like role-based messaging, on-call scheduling, and integration with nurse call systems. TigerConnect positions itself as infrastructure for clinical communication, connecting physicians, nurses, and staff across departments and facilities.

TigerConnect has achieved recognition as a 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for Clinical Communication and Collaboration, reflecting its position as a market leader in the space. The platform is HITRUST certified and offers a $1 million security guarantee—unusual in healthcare software—demonstrating confidence in its security posture.

Pricing ranges from $8-20 per user per month depending on features and organization size, making it accessible to mid-sized healthcare organizations while scaling to enterprise deployments. TigerConnect is designed for healthcare organizations seeking to modernize clinical communication—it's not a telehealth platform for patient visits or a consumer-facing tool.
best_for: Hospitals replacing pagers with secure messaging
Care coordination teams managing patient handoffs
not_for: Individual practitioners needing patient video visits
Small practices seeking simple telehealth software
Practices without IT infrastructure for platform deployment

pricing.notes: Volume discounts available. $1M security guarantee included.
